gh_2ab32c94b1bcf6d5363fdebe.title: Full-Stack / Frontend / Backend Developer - Remote - FT
gh_2ab32c94b1bcf6d5363fdebe.description:
Location
- Remote

## Salary Expectation
- Competitive, based on experience and skills

 Requirements
- Experience in full-stack, frontend, or backend software development
- Strong understanding of web application architecture and modern development practices
- Experience with Web3, blockchain, or decentralized applications
- Familiarity with blockchain integration, smart contracts, and Web3 APIs
- Knowledge of security, performance optimization, and scalable system design
- Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows

 Skills

 Must Have
- Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript
- Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js
- Backend development experience with Node.js or similar technologies
- Knowledge of REST APIs, databases, and application architecture
- Understanding of Web3 technologies, wallets, and blockchain interaction
- Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code

 Ideally
- Experience with Solidity and smart contract development
- Familiarity with Ethereum, EVM-compatible networks, or other blockchain ecosystems
- Experience with ethers.js, viem, or Web3.js
- Knowledge of DeFi, NFTs, tokenization, or decentralized applications
- Experience with Docker, cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines
- Familiarity with smart contract security and blockchain transaction workflows

 Responsibilities

 You’ll be responsible for
- Developing and maintaining scalable web applications with a focus on Web3 functionality
- Building responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces
- Designing and implementing backend services, APIs, and database integrations
- Integrating blockchain networks, smart contracts, and Web3 wallets
- Optimizing application performance, reliability, and security
- Collaborating with product managers, designers, and other developers
- Participating in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions

 You can bring
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
- A proactive approach to development and continuous improvement
- Attention to detail and commitment to code quality
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team
- Interest in blockchain technology and decentralized products

 Why it would be awesome to work with us
- Opportunity to work on innovative Web3 and blockchain projects
- Flexible remote work environment
- Collaborative team with opportunities for professional growth
- Exposure to modern technologies and emerging blockchain ecosystems
- Opportunity to contribute to technical decisions and product development

 Interesting Engineering Projects
- Developing decentralized applications and Web3-enabled platforms
- Integrating blockchain networks and smart contracts into web applications
- Building secure wallet authentication and transaction workflows
- Designing scalable backend services for blockchain-based products
- Improving performance and reliability of Web3 applications

 Contact
- Homepage: veyrion.capital
- Email: hire@veyrion.capital
- Google Form : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeOR_lI1Uuk24chxTw3qEhVKEl4uB9wQsFo2nJxnFoNoOiCRw/viewform

## 公司/团队介绍
https://aelf.com/

## 薪资福利待遇
$5000 - $6500 / month

## 地点
远程

## 工作性质

全职远程

## 🌱  **岗位职责：**

1️⃣  定义产品愿景和战略，制定清晰的路线图和迭代计划。

2️⃣  管理公链产品生命周期，包括市场研究、竞争分析、需求收集、产品规划和发布后评估。

3️⃣  与技术团队合作，确保产品功能和性能符合技术可行性和业务目标。

4️⃣  设计和优化用户界面和用户体验，提高用户满意度和参与度。

5️⃣  制定和执行产品推出计划，包括内部测试、用户反馈收集和产品优化。

6️⃣  分析产品性能数据，基于数据驱动的决策进行产品迭代。

7️⃣  与市场和销售团队合作，制定市场进入策略和推广计划。

8️⃣  跟踪行业趋势和新兴技术，评估其对产品的影响和潜在的整合机会。

9️⃣  管理产品预算和资源，确保项目按时按预算完成。

## 🌵  **岗位要求：**

1️⃣  学士学位，计算机科学、工程或相关领域优先。

2️⃣  3年以上产品经验，有区块链公链或Web3产品经验者优先。

3️⃣  熟悉区块链技术、加密货币和智能合约。

4️⃣  能够与工程师有效沟通技术需求和解决方案。

5️⃣  出色的项目管理能力，能够在快节奏的环境中管理多个项目。

6️⃣  优秀的沟通和人际交往能力，能够跨部门协作。

7️⃣  数据驱动，具备强大的分析和解决问题的能力。

## 如何申请
